description: Find the Last Price tool for a task. This connection lists only the tools that reach a price; the server has over 300 more (pricing functions, routing, experiments, webhooks, billing, orders, the marketplace and more). Pass query, a few words for the job, and get back the best matching tools with their full input schemas. Then call one with call_tool, or by its name. With no query it lists every tool name.

limit.description: How many tools to return. Defaults to 5.

query.description: What you want to do, in a few words, e.g. "create a webhook" or "experiment results".

name: search_tools
